text:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — FolioHealth renewal is trending AT-RISK. Renewal in ~45 days. We saw a ~40% drop in API tokens last 30d and the primary contact switched to a new Head of ML. Also heard they’re running a POC with Atlas AI. Need quick triage and playbook.

Ajay (AE): Thanks — what’s the baseline and when did the drop start? Any whisper on price push from their side? :thinking:

Maria (CSM): Baseline was ~1.2M tokens/mo, now ~0.7M. Drop started ~2025-01-20 after their last deploy. On the price side they mentioned cost concerns and want clearer SLOs for latency/cost. I have a notes excerpt from the QBR: "new Head of ML is focused on integrations and predictable unit cost — Atlas offering native EHR connector." 

OpsBot: Account snapshot (last 60d):
```
account: FolioHealth
tokens_60d: 2.8M -> 1.6M (-42%)
active_users: 73 -> 46 (-37%)
error_rate: 0.6% -> 0.9% (+0.3pp)
avg_p95_latency: 320ms -> 340ms
last_deploy: 2025-01-18
open_tickets: 2 (billing, connector)
```

Sana (Eng): Possible vectors:
- prompt or model change in their deploy on 2025-01-18
- new rate-limiting or quota misconfig
- frontend/UX change reducing calls
I can run a quick traffic diff + token-profile by endpoint and check for a prompt change. Should have initial findings in 4 hrs.

Leo (PM): Proposed playbook:
1) Quick call (30m) with new Head of ML + Ajay to surface priorities and Atlas POC status.
2) Share a short usage trend deck + 2 concrete cost/perf levers (batching + quantized model variant) — Maria.
3) Offer a technical 1:1 workshop to integrate our EHR connector pattern or a parallel eval with Dedicated for predictable pricing — trial incentive optional.
4) Root-cause validation from Eng (Sana) and action plan.

Ajay (AE): I can get the 30m intro scheduled. Prefer within 24h to avoid them going deeper on Atlas. Want to avoid discounts before we surface value — focus on ops + quick wins.

Maria (CSM): OK Ajay to coordinate scheduling. Action owners:
- Ajay (AE): book 30m intro with Head of ML + key stakeholders by EOD PDT (owner)
- Maria (CSM): prepare 2-slide usage + unit-cost explainer and one-pager on integration options (due before call)
- Sana (Eng): share traffic diff + top-3 root-cause hypotheses (ETA 4h)
- Leo (PM): prepare suggested workshop agenda and migration/integration checklist (ETA tomorrow noon)

Sana (Eng): Confirmed. Will post findings in thread and attach a small query snippet I ran:
```
SELECT endpoint, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM prod_logs
WHERE ts >= '2025-01-01' AND account='folio'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Maria (CSM): Also note: customer has an open billing ticket asking about overages and forecast variance. That’s likely contributing to urgency. I’ll sync with finance on a short note to reconcile any surprises before the call.

OpsBot: Reminder created: follow-up task for FolioHealth triage assigned to Maria, Ajay, Sana. Due_by: 1751300000 (UNIX)

Leo (PM): If this looks like a competitor move, we should prep a short competitive brief — key differentiators: unified runtime, predictable cost, private deploy option. I’ll draft 1-pager.

Maria (CSM): Good. Last ask — if we confirm usage drop is due to config/deploy, we lead with fixing ROI rather than discount. If it’s integration gap (EHR connector) we propose a scoped implementation SOW + Dedicated trial as proof.

Ajay (AE): On it. Will update thread after scheduling. :calendar:

Maria (CSM): Thanks team — please post updates here. If Sana finds a quick config fix we’ll request an immediate patch and follow up with a success milestone to rebuild confidence. :white_check_mark:
